archetypes.name: The Maker
archetypes.tagline: You'd rather build it than talk about it.
archetypes.description: Hands-on and practical, you love seeing real results. Tools can mean a wrench, a keyboard, or directing AI to ship something - work you can point at and say 'I made that.'

archetypes.name: The Investigator
archetypes.tagline: You have to know how it actually works.
archetypes.description: Curious and analytical, you love solving puzzles and digging into ideas. You'd happily go down a research rabbit hole and come out with the answer nobody else found.

archetypes.name: The Creator
archetypes.tagline: You make things that didn't exist before.
archetypes.description: Expressive and original, you think in images, sounds, and ideas. You need freedom to improvise and a space to make things that feel like you.

archetypes.name: The Connector
archetypes.tagline: You're happiest when you're helping someone.
archetypes.description: Warm and people-first, you're the one friends come to. You feel most fulfilled when your work directly helps, teaches, or heals real people.

archetypes.name: The Trailblazer
archetypes.tagline: You see the big picture and go get it.
archetypes.description: Bold and persuasive, you love leading, pitching, and growing things. You're energized by competition, ownership, and turning a vision into reality.

archetypes.name: The Organizer
archetypes.tagline: You turn chaos into a clean system.
archetypes.description: Structured and reliable, you love order, accuracy, and a good plan. People trust you to keep the details straight and the trains running on time.
